def span_features(text, spans):
    if not spans:
        return []
    def h(p, x):
        return bool(re.search(p, x, re.I))
    out = []
    for a, b in spans:
        a = max(0, min(len(text), a)); b = max(a, min(len(text), b))
        lo = text.rfind("\n", 0, a) + 1
        hi = text.find("\n", b)
        if hi < 0:
            hi = len(text)
        d = text[a:b]; c = text[lo:hi]
        out.append([
            h(r"mark(?:ed)?|identif(?:y|ied)|designat(?:e|es)|reduc(?:e|ed) to writ", d) and h(r"confidential|proprietary", c),
            h(r"oral(?:ly)?|verbal|spoken", d),
            h(r"circumstance|reasonabl(?:e|y) understood|reasonable business person", d),
            h(r"deemed|automatically|shall constitute", d) and h(r"confidential", c),
            h(r"business|financ|customer|market|personnel|employee|operation|asset|contract|address|forecast", d),
            h(r"technical|software|engineering|design|algorithm|invention|process|system", d),
            h(r"shall not include|does not include|exclude|obligations? .* not (?:apply|extend)", c),
            h(r"independent(?:ly)? (?:develop|acquir|deriv)|developed .* without (?:use|access|reference)", d),
            h(r"third part|source other than|from others|non.?confidential basis", d),
            h(r"right to independently|may .* developing|receiving information from other|similar .* product|similar .* information", c)
        ])
    return out

def span_features(text, spans):
    if not spans:
        return []
    def h(p, x):
        return bool(re.search(p, x, re.I))
    out = []
    for a, b in spans:
        a = max(0, min(len(text), a)); b = max(a, min(len(text), b))
        lo = text.rfind("\n", 0, a) + 1
        hi = text.find("\n", b)
        if hi < 0:
            hi = len(text)
        d = text[a:b]; c = text[lo:hi]
        copy = h(r"cop(?:y|ies|ied)|reproduc", c)
        out.append([
            h(r"employee|internal .* staff|officer|director", d),
            h(r"consultant|agent|contractor|affiliate|representative|third part", d),
            h(r"counsel|attorney|accountant|professional adviser|financial advisor|banker", d),
            h(r"need to know|require access|strictly need|directly concerned|involved in", d),
            h(r"agree .* bound|confidentiality agreement|secrecy agreement|terms no less|keep .* confidence", d),
            h(r"may disclose|permitted to disclose|except .* employees|except .* representatives", c),
            copy and h(r"necessary|required|strictly|prior written (?:consent|approval)|written permission|except for", c),
            copy and h(r"shall not|not copy|not reproduce|without prior written|agrees not", c),
            copy and h(r"return|destroy|no copies .* retained", c),
            h(r"solicit|employ|hire|contact for employment", c) and h(r"employee|officer|director|personnel|restricted person", c),
            h(r"solicitation", c) and h(r"prox(?:y|ies)|vote|consent", c),
            h(r"general advertisement|general solicitation|recruiting .* not specifically|responds? to .* advertisement|initiates discussions", c)
        ])
    return out
